The last Fernandina Island Tortoise is looking for a mate! The ghost turtle of volcano island has been found. After decades of search, Fernanda, the last of her species, was found in 2019. And since then there have been efforts to save her species. But how to do it? Lessons from other tortoises could help us find an answer.
